text:
Sasha: Heads-up — starting a soft-lift of router routes for canary v2026.03. Plan: 5% -> 20% over ~20m. Change window now until 14:30 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for v2026.03. Applied routing policy: initial green=5%. Monitoring p95, p99, and 5xx for route /api/generate.

jon: Ack. I'll tail logs and dashboard. If p95 > 1500ms or error-rate > 3% we stop and discuss rollback.

Priya: Can we pin session affinity to green for this cohort? Last time some long sessions got bounced. Example command: `router-cli set-affinity --mode=sticky --to=green`

Kevin-oncall: Noted. We saw a small p95 hump in the staging run at 500 rps. Plan: hold at 5% for 10m, then 10m at 10%, then 20% if stable.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created metric alert /alerts/1724681230-canary-p95. Auto-rollback is OFF for this soft-lift (manual ops only).

Sasha: Manual rollback play: if alert fires or we see >1% errors, run `router-cli shift --to=blue --force` and pin roll to v2025.12. Also call out on this thread before executing.

jon: Also adding quick tags for infra debugging: `infra tag add canary=2026_03` so we can quickly filter traces.

Priya: If affinity fails, fallback is cookie-based routing: `router-cli set-cookie-fallback on` — will put that in the ops runbook.

Kevin-oncall: I'll run smoke tests in 5m: single-turn gen, multi-turn chat, embeddings path. Ping me if you see >200ms regressions on those.

Sasha: Starting ramp to 10% now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: route-weight-update: green=10% (applied at 1724681290). Monitoring window = 5m.

jon: Quick metrics after 5m: p95 = 180ms, errors = 0.2%. Good so far. Proceed to 20% in 5m.

Sasha: Ramping to 20% now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: route-weight-update: green=20% (applied at 1724681375).

Priya: Verified session samples — no affinity drops observed.

Kevin-oncall: Seeing a slight p99 tail increase on long flows (2.2s -> 2.6s) at 20%. Could be scheduling/kv-cache warmup. Watching.

Sasha: Thresholds we agreed: if p99 > 3s OR errors > 1% => rollback. Otherwise hold until end of change window and promote.

jon: Updated the release notes with the rollback snippet and pin instructions: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03#rollback

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary ramp complete. Holding at green=20% until change window end 14:30 UTC. No auto-rollback configured.

Sasha: Thanks all. Post-run action items: capture traces for the p99 tail, open PR for quantization tuning that changed behavior, and add an ops checklist for cookie-fallback. I'll file tickets after the window. :white_check_mark:
